annotations.title: UK company counts by area and sector

description: Free, no API key. Returns a count of UK companies. Use measure new_companies for companies formed in one month, by postcode area (for example LS) and SIC division. The same month a year earlier is not given, because closed companies are missing from older months. Use measure live_companies for live companies by postcode district (for example LS1) and SIC division. Live means status Active, including the status "Active - Proposal to Strike off". The postcode is the registered office, not the trading site. London and virtual offices raise some counts. New company counts include only companies still on the register snapshot, so older months read low. Returns value null with a reason when a group has fewer than 10 companies. Some larger groups are also null, so a hidden group cannot be worked out from totals. Counts only, no advice. Returns JSON with fields measure, value, n, unit, postcode_area or postcode_district, sic_division, sector_label, period, as_of, register_snapshot_date, source, coverage_note, url, or value and reason.

measure.description: new_companies counts companies formed in a month. live_companies counts live companies.

month.description: Optional, for new_companies. The month, YYYY-MM, one of the last 12 full months. Default is the latest full month.

postcode_area.description: Optional, for new_companies. The letters at the start of the registered office postcode, for example LS. Leave out for all of the UK.

postcode_district.description: Optional, for live_companies. The part of the registered office postcode before the space, for example LS1. Leave out for all of the UK.

sic_division.description: Optional. UK SIC 2007 division, 2 digits. For example 41 for construction of buildings. Leave out for all sectors.
